title: National Center for Education Statistics: Digest of Education Statistics tables and IPEDS data files
agency: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics
questions: public school enrollment by grade over time
number of teachers and pupil/teacher ratio
current expenditure per pupil by state
enrollment at a college or all colleges in a state (IPEDS)
completions by CIP code and award level
admissions and yield at a university

manual.how: Digest: open the table page (https://nces.ed.gov/programs/digest/current_tables.asp, then the table) and click its Excel link, or https://nces.ed.gov/programs/digest/d<yy>/tables/xls/tabn<table>.xlsx. IPEDS: download https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/data/<FILE>.zip from the Complete Data Files page (https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/datacenter/DataFiles.aspx). Upload the file as saved with ingest.

cache.why: Files are replaced when NCES revises them; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: NCES publications and IPEDS data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics, {dataset}, nces.ed.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Published table or institution file? Digest tables give national (and often state) totals as NCES published them; IPEDS files give one row per institution to filter and sum. Default: a Digest table for national or state totals, IPEDS for named colleges.

Which year? Digest tables are labelled by school year or fall; IPEDS files by collection year (EFFY2023 = 12-month enrollment for 2022-23). Say which, and whether the IPEDS file is provisional or revised (_rv).
